title: 第21章 千年尸魔化境尸身第22章 爆头你还能认出来
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
lines: “千年尸魔？”
陆渊眼底闪过一抹异色。
刘韫嗯了一声，神情严肃，不像是说谎。
“不错，我长生教有秘法，以活人心脏炼化尸魔心窍，可将这千年尸魔收为尸宠。”
“炼成了吗？”
“快了，只要再等一个月圆之夜，让尸魔吃下活人心脏，我就能彻底收服这只千年尸魔。”
下一个月圆之夜，就是后天。
“那你大概率是等不到了。”
陆渊眼中寒芒乍现，手底迸发晶芒。
刘韫浑身一个激灵，连忙后撤大喊一声。
看着眼前的晶刺停滞，他这才长舒一口气，内心已是惊骇不已。
他活了半辈子，什么妖魔鬼怪没见过？什么穷凶极恶没见过？
可眼前这人年纪轻轻，看着不大，一身杀性连他这种老江湖都心惊肉跳。
最让他心惊的是对方那双眼睛。
太平静了，没有任何情绪。
没有愤怒，没有仇恨，只有纯粹至极的杀意。
青州镇魔司是何时出了这么一尊杀神？
他张了张嘴，想客套两句缓和一下气氛，可话到嘴边又咽了回去。
生怕再多说一句废话，晶刺就直接洞穿脑门。
“还有一件事......”刘韫喉结艰难动了动，声音发颤，“祖师爷的封印大阵早已破损，是我以秘法掌控尸魔心窍，才勉强将其镇在山神庙之下。”
“若我死了，秘法也就破了，到时候千年尸魔破封而出，赤霞县方圆千里都将生灵涂炭。”
陆渊眼底闪过一抹怀疑，“真有这么邪乎？”
“大人明鉴，那可是千年尸魔啊！”
“当年祖师爷以玄境修为都无法将其斩杀，如今在地气之下洗炼千年，或许修为没有寸进，但那尸身已是当世罕有。”
刘韫越说越有地气，声音也不颤了，摇杆也直了。
“所以，这位大人......”
“你也不想让这只千年尸魔破出封印祸乱苍生吧？”
刘韫盯着陆渊的眼睛，想从中看到一丝犹豫，恐惧，或是动摇。
然而并没有。
反常的，他竟然从对方眼中看到了一闪而逝的兴奋。
只见陆渊嘴角勾起一个微小弧度，那笑容，令他整个人如坠冰窟。
“也就是说，只要杀了你，那只尸魔就会主动出现？”
刘韫瞳孔骤然一缩。
“你疯了！那可是千年尸魔！千年尸魔啊！”
“若它失控，赤霞县方圆千里都将掀起腥风血雨！所有人都会死！也包括你！”
嚓！
话音刚落，他的头颅就被锋棱晶刺贯穿，身躯重重地倒在地上。
“腥风血雨？我怕风浪大？”
content_en:
"Thousand-year-old corpse demon?"
A strange color flashed in Lu Yuan's eyes.
Liu Yun hummed, his expression serious, and it didn't look like he was lying.
"Yes, our Immortality Cult has a secret method to refine the corpse demon's heart with the heart of a living person, so that we can take this thousand-year-old corpse demon into a corpse pet."
"Is it finished?"
"It's almost time. As long as I wait for the full moon night and let the corpse demon eat the heart of a living person, I can completely conquer this thousand-year-old corpse demon."
The next full moon night is the day after tomorrow.
"Then you most likely won't be able to wait."
A cold gleam suddenly appeared in Lu Yuan's eyes, and crystal light burst out from the bottom of his hand.
Liu Yun's whole body trembled, and he quickly retreated and shouted.
"More!!!"
Seeing the crystal thorns in front of him stagnant, he let out a long sigh of relief, but he was already horrified in his heart.
He has lived half his life, what monsters and monsters has he not seen? What kind of evil have you never seen before?
But the man in front of him was young, he didn't look big, and he had a murderous intent that would scare even an old man like him.
What frightened him the most was the other person's eyes.
Too calm, devoid of any emotion.
There was no anger, no hatred, just pure and extreme killing intent.
When did the Qingzhou Demon-Suppressing Division create such a murderous god?
He opened his mouth, wanting to say a few polite words to lighten the atmosphere, but he swallowed the words as they reached his lips.
He was afraid that if he said one more nonsense, the crystal thorn would pierce his forehead.
"One more thing..." Liu Yun's Adam's apple moved with difficulty, and his voice trembled, "The sealing formation of the Grandmaster has long been damaged. It was only through my secret method that I controlled the mind of the corpse demon that I managed to suppress it under the mountain temple."
"If I die, the secret method will be broken. When the thousand-year-old zombie demon breaks out of the seal, all living beings in Chixia County will be devastated for thousands of miles."
Lu Yuan's eyes flashed with suspicion, "Is it really so evil?"
"My lord Mingjian, that is a thousand-year-old corpse demon!"
"Back then, my ancestor was unable to kill him with his cultivation in the Xuan Realm. Now, after being refined under the earth's energy for thousands of years, his cultivation may not have improved, but that corpse is already rare in the world."
The more Liu Yun spoke, the more confident he became, his voice no longer trembled, and the rocker became straighter.
"So, this sir..."
"You don't want this thousand-year-old corpse demon to break the seal and cause trouble to the people, right?"
Liu Yun stared at Lu Yuan's eyes, hoping to see a hint of hesitation, fear, or wavering.
But no.
Unusually, he actually saw a flash of excitement in the other person's eyes.
The corner of Lu Yuan's mouth curled up slightly, and that smile made him feel as if he had fallen into an ice cave.
"In other words, as long as I kill you, the corpse demon will appear on its own initiative?"
Liu Yun's pupils suddenly shrank.
"You're crazy! That's the Thousand-Year-Old Corpse Demon! The Thousand-Year-Old Corpse Demon!"
"If it gets out of control, there will be a bloody storm thousands of miles around Chixia County! Everyone will die! Including you!"
Crack!
As soon as he finished speaking, his head was pierced by sharp crystal thorns, and his body fell heavily to the ground.
"A bloody storm? I'm afraid of strong wind and waves?"
